analysis.title: US Equities Mid-Day Color - GS Equities Mid-Day Color 28 Oct 2026
key_insights: US stocks are flat midday on 10/28 with the S&P 500 within 100bps of its all-time high. The SPX is trading in a 32bp range during the busiest week of earnings, with the FOMC decision at 2pm and hyperscaler earnings that night. Only a handful of thematic baskets are moving more than 1 sigma.
AI baskets lead but the desk sees no chasing. Memory is +4.5%, Grid Revamp +2.2% and Data Centers +1.7%. Mag7 is -55bps and Hyperscalers are -25bps ahead of tonight's prints.

Prime brokerage recap for 10/27: US equities were net bought (+2.0 SDs one-year), driven by long buying and short covering at a 1.4 to 1 ratio. Both Single Names (+2.4 SDs) and Macro Products (+0.8 SDs) saw net buying, with long buys exceeding short covers in each.

Hedge fund leverage: gross leverage fell 1.1 pts to 313.7%, which is the 85th percentile over one year and the 97th percentile over five years. Net leverage rose 0.9 pts to 72.8%, which is the 7th percentile over one year and the 40th percentile over five years.
The desk rates MSFT positioning at 8/10 ahead of earnings. Sentiment and positioning have improved over the last quarter but are not fully 'full' given longer-term AI debates.

For MSFT, investors want strong Azure growth. GIR sees a reasonable upside case of Azure growth of 46-47% cc with 2QFY guidance of about 46-47% cc. M365 Commercial Cloud growth of about 17-18% cc in 1QFY is also possible as usage scales. On the call, the focus will be capacity additions and allocation, capex and Maia updates.
GS franchise flows are light, down 20% vs the 10-day moving average. Long-only clients are slightly better buyers, with demand in comm svcs, industrials and info tech against supply in health care.
Hedge funds are 4.3% better for sale, with supply in info tech and comm svcs against demand in financials and health care. The short ratio is 45.64%.
Chart of the Day: the GS AI Health Care basket (GSHLCAIP) has outperformed the Broad AI basket (GSTMTAIP) and the broader health care sector by 20-30pp year-to-date.
earnings_insights: MSFT preview from the GS desk (earnings due the night of 10/28): positioning 8/10. GIR upside case is Azure growth of 46-47% cc with 2QFY guidance of about 46-47% cc. It also sees potential M365 Commercial Cloud growth of about 17-18% cc in 1QFY. These are forecasts, not reported figures.
Hyperscaler earnings are due the night of 10/28. The Hyperscalers basket is -25bps midday and Mag7 is -55bps ahead of the prints.

macro_indicators.interpretation: The desk cites the FOMC at 2pm as one of the catalysts, along with the busiest week of earnings and hyperscaler prints, that has not yet moved stocks. SPX is in a 32bp range.

MSFT positioning is 8/10 and not fully 'full', with longer-term AI debates still open.
